drhp.business: Mamata Machinery designs and manufactures machinery for the flexible packaging industry, with an installed base of over 5,400 machines operating across more than 80 countries. Backed by expertise in polymer processing, plastic rheology, converting, filling and sealing systems, it serves both brand owners and convertors through a single technology platform. Over more than 35 years it has grown from a single-product manufacturer into a complete provider of flexible packaging machinery present across the entire value chain, from co-extrusion to converting to packaging.

drhp.expansion: Mamata's expansion is footprint- and technology-led rather than a large plant build-out. The operating model deliberately combines in-house capabilities across design, software development, engineering, electrical integration, testing and critical operations with a robust network of specialised manufacturing partners, an approach the Company says enhances scalability and operational agility while allowing efficient capital deployment. sk.overview: The DRHP frames Dies and Moulds as a segment of India's Tooling Market and as the backbone for precision manufacturing of plastic moulding products across automotive, pipe fittings, industrial components and electronics. Per the Ken Research Report the India Dies and Moulds Market was valued at INR 45,400 crore in FY'25 and is projected to grow at an 11.5% CAGR to FY'30F, with Automotive Moulds the largest application at INR 25.2 thousand crore in FY'25 and B2B/OEM the dominant distribution channel.
